intent: outerpale-startup: the session-start hook is now silent when the repository already has its own CLAUDE.md; it no longer prints a reminder.

files.hooks/session-start.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0
[ -f "$root/CLAUDE.md" ] && exit 0
echo "outerpale-startup: no CLAUDE.md in $(basename "$root")"

test.risk: the hook stopped telling the session about the repository's CLAUDE.md
test.body:
set -e
d=$(mktemp -d); git init -q "$d/r"; touch "$d/r/CLAUDE.md"
out=$(cd "$d/r" && bash "$OLDPWD/hooks/session-start.sh")
[ -n "$out" ] || { echo 'FAIL: the hook said nothing in a repository with a CLAUDE.md'; exit 1; }
test.output: FAIL: the hook said nothing in a repository with a CLAUDE.md
